level.why: 口說問答，包含 depending on、because 子句與 to ensure 目的結構；字彙如 cross-section、production volume、conduct tests 屬製造與品質專業用語，需理解形狀、成本與耐用度之間的關係。

passage:
Do carbon fiber tubes have to be round?
No, not at all. Carbon fiber tubes don't have to be round.

They can also have square, rectangular, or oval cross-sections, depending on the design requirements.

However, the manufacturing process and cost will depend on the shape and production volume.

For Super Lite, we're currently using straight, round carbon fiber tubes because they're readily available and don't require custom tooling.

Is the carbon fiber frame durable enough for everyday use?

Carbon fiber is lightweight and strong, but its durability depends on the design and manufacturing quality.

For a stroller, we need to consider everyday loads, impacts, and repeated folding.

Before mass production, we must conduct strength, durability, and safety tests to ensure the frame meets the required standards.
zh:
碳纖維管一定要是圓形的嗎？
不，完全不必。碳纖維管不一定要是圓形的。

依設計需求，它們也可以有方形、長方形或橢圓形的截面。

不過，製造流程與成本會取決於形狀與生產量。

對於 Super Lite，我們目前使用的是直的圓形碳纖維管，因為它們容易取得，而且不需要客製化工裝。

碳纖維車架耐用到足以日常使用嗎？

碳纖維既輕又堅固，但其耐用度取決於設計與製造品質。

對於嬰兒推車，我們需要考慮日常負載、衝擊以及反覆折疊。

在量產之前，我們必須進行強度、耐用度與安全測試，以確保車架符合所需標準。

vocab.col: increase production volume / low production volume

questions.q: Which cross-sections can carbon fiber tubes have, according to the speaker?
opts: Round, square, rectangular, or oval ones
why: 講者說碳纖維管不一定要是圓形的。
講者說除了方形與長方形，也可以是橢圓形或圓形。
講者說不只橢圓形，還有其他形狀可選。
正解：講者說碳纖維管可以有圓形、方形、長方形或橢圓形的截面，依設計需求而定。

questions.q: What will the manufacturing process and cost depend on?
why: 正解：講者說製造流程與成本取決於形狀與生產量。
文中沒有提到顏色。
文中沒有提到供應商的所在地。
文中沒有說製造成本取決於推車的重量。

questions.q: Why is Super Lite currently using straight, round carbon fiber tubes?
opts: They are stronger than other shapes
They are readily available and do not require custom tooling
They are lighter than square tubes
why: 文中沒有說圓管比其他形狀更堅固。
IATA 是機艙行李尺寸規範，與管材形狀無關。
正解：講者說因為它們容易取得，而且不需要客製化工裝。
文中沒有比較圓管與方管的重量。

questions.q: The design must ______ both strength and weight requirements.
why: satisfaction 是名詞，不能放在 must 之後作動詞。
正解：must 後面需接原形動詞，satisfy 表示「滿足」。
satisfied 是過去式或過去分詞，不能接在 must 之後。
satisfying 是現在分詞或形容詞，不能接在 must 之後。

questions.q: Our products are tested ______ to make sure they are safe.
why: regular 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞片語 are tested。
regularity 是名詞，不能修飾動詞片語 are tested。
regulate 是動詞，不能放在 tested 之後修飾。
正解：需要副詞修飾動詞 tested，regularly 表示「定期地」。

questions.q: Every stroller must pass a series of safety tests ______ it goes on sale.
why: 正解：before 作連接詞，表示「在……之前」，連接子句 it goes on sale。
between 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句。
despite 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句，語意也不符。
during 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句。
